NIGHT SENTINEL:
ARKHAM PROTOCOL

An original fan-inspired 3D open-city prototype. Patrol a rain-slick night city on foot and in your armored Interceptor (pursuit + battle mode). Glide between towers with your cape, grapnel-boost, use Detective Vision, chain Freeflow strikes/counters, raise the GTA-style Threat system, and complete 3 story missions to face the Warden. All art & code are original — no ripped Batman / GTA assets.
